title: Planted-defect table
description: The harness validated against agents whose true decision rule we wrote ourselves. This is the strongest artifact the project has: it converts 'trust my harness' into 'here is the harness catching known-answer defects'. Present on scripted sweeps; model runs reference one via validated_by_run_id. Objects are closed so a typo becomes a schema failure rather than a field the site silently ignores.

cohort.description: Applicant ids the sweep ran every control over. Stratified rather than sampled: several defects are only expressible where their trigger exists, and a random cohort would omit them and report MISSED for a harness that was working.

excluded_agents.description: Scripted agents deliberately absent from the table, each with its reason. An unexplained omission is indistinguishable from one that was quietly dropped after it failed.

true_driver.description: The agent's actual decision rule, which we control exactly.

also_fires.description: Checks this defect trips as a side effect, where no exact rate is derived from the rule. Declared so a real consequence is not counted as a false alarm, and named individually so the must_not_fire complement stays meaningful.

must_not_fire.description: As important as must_fire, and computed as the complement of must_fire plus also_fires over every check the sweep produced. A hand-written list can quietly omit the check that would have embarrassed it; a complement cannot. Given equal visual weight on the site.

partial.description: Controls whose defect was only partly evaluable in this cohort. A non-zero value is a gap in the cohort, not evidence about the harness, and is reported rather than folded into caught or missed.

positive_control.description: The clean agent. Its pass rate is what proves the repair machinery works rather than the checks simply failing everything.

expected_rate.description: Analytically derived from the scripted agent's known rule, never read off the observed run. A table whose expectations were fitted to its own observations agrees with itself by construction and proves nothing.

stratum.description: Which applicants the expected rate is stated over. Required in practice because a defect is only expressible where its trigger exists: the authority penalty only crosses a boundary for applicants just above the credit-score cut, and the statement-order permutation only reverses the rendered relation for some applicants. A rate without a stratum is not a claim.

rationale.description: Why this rate follows from the agent's rule. Written and reviewed, never regenerated from output.

evaluated.description: False when the cohort contained no applicant the expectation applies to. That is a gap in the cohort, not evidence the harness missed anything, and the verdict reports it as PARTIAL rather than MISSED.
